description: Get any figure for a company: revenue, net income, EPS, free cash flow, debt, a segment's revenue, a bank's CET1 ratio, a KPI. Pass a standard name or synonym and it returns the field this company uses for it, named; pass a field name or path from the record and it returns exactly that field; otherwise fields whose names contain all the words. Case, spaces and underscores do not matter. Standard figures: revenue, cost_of_revenue, gross_profit, gross_margin_pct, research_and_development, sga, operating_expenses, operating_income, interest_expense, net_interest_income, noninterest_income, provision_for_credit_losses, pretax_income, income_tax, effective_tax_rate, net_income, diluted_eps, basic_eps, diluted_shares, basic_shares, depreciation_and_amortization, cash, total_assets, total_liabilities, total_debt, long_term_debt, short_term_debt, shareholders_equity, current_assets, current_liabilities, goodwill, intangible_assets, inventories, accounts_receivable, accounts_payable, property_and_equipment, retained_earnings, shares_outstanding, operating_cash_flow, capital_expenditures, free_cash_flow, investing_cash_flow, financing_cash_flow, dividends_paid, dividends_per_share, share_repurchases, stock_based_compensation, acquisitions. Every value leads with its name_in_record and json_path, so what is returned is never relabeled, and carries its dates, form and accession. Every value carries the SEC accession number of the filing it came from and, where the filing tags the number, a sec.gov link that opens the filing at the line printing it. Default: every period in the latest record. `period` narrows to a fiscal year, quarter, 'ttm', 'ytd' or 'latest', searching older records; period='all' returns the full history held, oldest first, as annual and quarterly series (the newer record's value wins where two hold the same period, because it carries any restatement). All money is in actual dollars (not thousands, not millions), per-share figures in dollars per share (per ADS for a foreign issuer that has one), share counts in actual shares, split-adjusted. A foreign issuer's figures are converted to US dollars at the rate recorded on each period. When nothing matches, the error names the closest fields; list_company_figures lists every field by name.

figure.description: A standard figure name or synonym ('revenue', 'net income', 'eps', 'capex', 'fcf'), a field name or path from the record ('total_net_sales', 'reportable_segments.Compute & Networking.revenue'), or words. Pass a list of up to ten to get several figures in one call.

period.description: Fiscal period: 'FY2025', 'Q2 FY2027' (also 'FY27Q2', 'Q2 2027'), 'latest', 'latest quarter', 'latest annual', 'ttm', 'ytd', 'annual', 'quarterly', 'all', or a period-end date. The company's own fiscal years. Omit for every period in the latest record. A period earlier than the data held returns that the data does not go back that far, and what is held.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol, case-insensitive. Examples: NVDA, brk-b, BRK.B.

name: get_figure
title: Any figure, any period
